status: PROPOSAL. Accounting measures only. No measure applies a tax rate, an election, a threshold, an applicability test, an ATC choice, a due date or a penalty (docs/adr/0007-books-supplies-measures-forms-owns-compliance.md).

units.money: integer centavos internally; decimal text with exactly two places in JSON (for example "290000.00"); no floats

period_basis.quarter: calendar quarter of the line's entry date (revenue-recognition date; D4 keeps the date policy with Books)
period_basis.month: calendar month of the entry date
period_basis.year: calendar year of the entry date
period_basis.year_to_date_before_period: from 1 January of the period's year up to the day before the period starts
period_basis.certificate_period: the certificate's own period_end falls in the period (not the entry date)

person_scope.taxpayer: the business owner's own lines (line person_scope self)
person_scope.spouse: the spouse's lines (line person_scope spouse); computed but refused by the bridge in MVP (EXC.SPOUSE_MVP)
person_scope.employee: payroll lines for employees (line person_scope employee); the measure is the sum over all employees of the business
person_scope.payor: certificate lines received from payors (line person_scope payor or self)

sign_convention.credit_positive: credit minus debit on the selected lines; a sale is positive, its reversal negative
sign_convention.debit_positive: debit minus credit on the selected lines; an expense or receivable is positive
sign_convention.reduction_positive: a reduction reported as a positive amount (for example a sales return of 10000.00 is "10000.00")

lineage.required: every value carries the line ids and signed amounts that sum to it; a same-window void and its reversal are netted and listed only as a count (REV.VOID_OPEN_PERIOD)

line_selection_rules: Selection is by line attributes (data/tax-attributes.v1.json), never by account number or subtype (ADR-0006).
Posted entries only. Memos never reach a measure.
Output VAT is a liability line, never a sales line (EXC.VAT_NOT_IN_SALES).
Payment receipts and bank deposits are not sales (EXC.BANK_DEPOSIT_NOT_SALES).
Measures come from transaction lines, never from a payable or receivable balance (EXC.PAYABLE_NOT_BASE).
A reversal of a sale dated in a later period counts once, in the reversal's period, as a negative line (REV.COUNT_ONCE, REV.LATER_PERIOD_RETURN_EVENT).

measures.description: Sales of goods and services before returns, allowances and discounts, net of output VAT.
Sales returns, reported as a positive reduction.
Sales allowances, reported as a positive reduction. Separate from returns and discounts.
Sales discounts granted, reported as a positive reduction. Separate from returns and allowances.
gross_sales less sales_returns, sales_allowances and sales_discounts. An accounting subtotal, not a tax base: which sales measure feeds a form box is a mapping rule.
measures.lineage: required (the union of the component lines; contra lines carry negative amounts)

measures.description: Cost of goods sold and direct cost of services.
Operating expenses, with a breakdown by category (the line's account key). Whether an expense is deductible is a tax question for Forms, not a Books measure.

Income outside the main business activity (interest, other income). Whether part of it was final-taxed at source is an evidence fact (final_tax_withheld); how that affects a form box is a mapping question (EXC.FINAL_TAX_INTEREST).
Gross compensation paid to employees: basic pay, statutory minimum wage, holiday/overtime/night-shift/hazard pay, 13th month and other benefits, and de minimis. Never the employer's contributions.
Basic pay of employees who are not minimum-wage earners.
Basic pay of employees recorded by payroll as minimum-wage earners (a payroll fact on the employee).
Holiday, overtime, night-shift differential and hazard pay, all employees.
measures.note: 1601-C item 16 takes this pay for minimum-wage earners only. The per-employee MWE split is planned (P6); until then the mapping fails closed when such lines exist.

measures.description: 13th month pay and other benefits paid in the period (gross, before any tax split).
measures.note: The year_to_date_before_period basis exists so the bridge can apply the one input-level tax rule it keeps (1601-C item 17, annual non-taxable cap). See data/rules/1601c-v2018.rules.json 1601C.II.17.

measures.description: De minimis benefits paid, as recorded by payroll.
EMPLOYEE shares withheld from pay: SSS or GSIS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, and union dues. Breakdown by scheme. Never the employer share.
EMPLOYER shares (expense side): SSS or GSIS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG. Kept separate from employee shares; it never feeds 1601-C item 19 (EXC.EMPLOYER_SHARE_NOT_19).
Tax withheld from employees' pay, as recorded by payroll. A fact: Books records the amount; it does not compute withholding.
Percentage tax withheld by payors per Form 2307 certificates with status received. Evidence with status; final withholding (2306, for example WB084) is a different document and never counts here.
Income tax withheld by payors per Form 2307 certificates with status received. Kept separate from the percentage-tax measure (EXC.IT_CWT_NOT_PT, EXC.PT_CWT_NOT_IT).
Form 2316 certificates received by the business owner from an employer (evidence with status). Planned with the evidence store (P4).
